description: This file defines a Vue.js composable hook named useBeforeUnload that manages prompting the user before they navigate away from the page. It adds event listeners for 'mousemove' to set up the 'beforeunload'' event, which prompts the user with a confirmation dialog if certain conditions are met.

methods.description: Main composable function that registers/unregisters event listeners to prompt the user before leaving the page based on the override flag.

methods.description: Event handler triggered during 'beforeunload' to potentially prompt the user if override is false.

methods.description: Registers the 'beforeunload' event listener if not already registered.
